He was convicted of murdering seven European-American women and one girl between May 1972 and April 1973. Years earlier, at the age of 15, Kemper had murdered his paternal grandparents. Kemper was nicknamed the "Co-ed Killer", as most of his non-familial victims were White American female college students hitchhiking in the vicinity of Santa Cruz County, California.
